name: o-json: the lit column crosses the selected row: the cell where they meet is drawn in list.cell.intersect (a background, out of the reverse bar), the lit column's header in list.header.intersect, and the "#" row numbers in list.rownum (list.rownum.intersect on the selected row); with list.cell-cursor underline, so the cursor on the crossing keeps list.cell.intersect, underlined
